name: cc-executor-subagents
description: Fast multi-agent executor for Claude Code. Splits quick repo tasks into independent slices, supports pre-defined plan execution with Codex high plan-vs-output review, uses AGY 3.6.0+ (antigravity-coder for implementation, antigravity-agent for read-only analysis/review) for front-end and large-context work, keeps Codex for backend, tests, and review, and reports without OpenSpec ceremony. Agent stack is configurable via a shared Project_Config (.orchestrator/project-config.md) instead of a fixed codex+agy pair.
